verdict.rationale: FreeAgent is accounting software, so an audit trail of ledger changes is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit log, change history or user-attributed edit tracking. The closest item, docs-9 (finding which user owns an API token), is an adjacent API feature and does not show who changed what or when.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
